invite.title: You have been invited
invite.description: Review who invited you and what it gives you access to before you sign in.
invite.metaDescription: Accept an invitation to the editor console.
invite.roleHint: Roles are named by their code, as they are throughout the console.
invite.signInBody: Accepting means signing in with {email}. That is the only address this invitation works for.
invite.acceptBody: You are signed in as {email}. Accepting adds this to your account straight away.
invite.acceptError: We could not accept this invitation. Refresh the page and try again.
invite.wrongAccountBody: This invitation was sent to {invited}, but you are signed in as {current}. Sign out and sign back in with the invited address to accept it.
invite.acceptedBody: This invitation has already been accepted. Sign in to reach your workspace.
invite.acceptedDoneBody: You now have access. Open the console to get started.
invite.acceptedNoMembership: This invitation was accepted, but the membership it reserved no longer exists. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
invite.expiredBody: Invitation links last {days} days. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
invite.revokedBody: The link is no longer valid. Contact the person who invited you if you think this is a mistake.
invite.unknownBody: Check that you copied the whole link from the email. If it keeps failing, ask for a new invitation.
invite.privacy: This page shows an invitation, not an account. Nothing is granted until you sign in with the invited address.
